text:
### Observed differences

- The clearest change is a reversal of sequence order around a stable middle. In the earlier window, the optional steps A19, A21 and A24 (each in roughly 30–36 of 100 traces) ran before A25 and A29 (in all traces), which ran before the always-present A20, A22 and A23. In the later window, A20, A22 and A23 sit early (mean relative position about 0.38–0.39, down from about 0.64–0.65), A25 (about 0.45) and A29 (about 0.64) keep their middle place, and A19, A21 and A24 now sit late (about 0.67, up from about 0.36–0.37) [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009].
- Pairwise relations confirm this as a near-deterministic flip: A25 preceded A20 in about 98 of 100 traces before and essentially never after, while A20 precedes A25 in about 97 of 100 traces in the later window; the same reversal holds between each of A19, A21, A24 and each of A20, A22, A23, A25, A29, with every pair observed in all 200 traces of both windows [REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, REL031, REL032, REL033, REL034, REL035, REL036].
- Participation of these activities barely moved (A20/A22/A23 in 100 of 100 traces in both windows; A19 about 31→33, A21 about 36→29, A24 about 36→39 in 100), so this is a change in ordering, not in how often these steps run [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007].
- A08 is executed far less often: about 64 of 100 traces in the earlier window versus about 29 of 100 in the later one; when it runs, it sits later (mean relative position about 0.26→0.41) and its previous fixed precedence over the always-present steps largely disappeared (A08 before A14: about 59 of 100 traces → about 1 of 100; A08 before A20: about 57 → about 18 of 100) [OCC003, POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL005].
- Three low-frequency steps became more common: A04 in about 7→21 of 100 traces, A06 about 7→24, A10 about 9→19 [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004].
- Typical spacing between always-present steps also shifted: A29 and A30 are now typically 2 steps apart (about 95 in 100) instead of 4–5, and A40 now typically precedes A25 by 4–5 steps instead of 2 [LAG026, LAG029].
- Several other qualifying lag items rest on only 1–3 observations in one window and are not relied on here [LAG002, LAG011, LAG017, LAG020, LAG021, LAG023, LAG025, LAG027, LAG028].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The control-flow family produced 79 qualifying items where fewer than 1 would be expected without a change (165 units tested), so the ensemble of differences is far larger than an unchanged process typically produces [screening.by_family.control_flow].

Main hypothesis: the relative order of two groups of activities reversed around a stable middle. In the earlier window a case typically ran A19/A21/A24 first, then A25/A29, then A20/A22/A23; in the later window it runs A20/A22/A23 first, then A25/A29, then A19/A21/A24. This is shown directly by relational evidence: 21 activity pairs, each observed in all 200 traces of both windows, flip from one near-deterministic order to the other, and the reversed orders were essentially absent in the earlier window, which argues against a mere shift in the mix of pre-existing variants; the position shifts of all six activities agree in direction while their participation stays similar [REL016, REL023, REL024, REL030, REL033, REL034, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007]. Limitations: positions are event positions within a case, not clock times, so the evidence establishes order, not timing; and it cannot show whether the steps themselves were re-sequenced or whether cases now route through a mirrored sequence that the earlier window did not contain — the evidence cannot distinguish these two readings.

Other differences: A08 runs in far fewer cases (about 64→29 of 100) and, when it runs, sits later and no longer precedes the always-present steps — a participation and placement change not covered by the main hypothesis [OCC003, POS001, REL001, REL005]; A04, A06 and A10 appear in roughly two to three times as many traces [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004]; and typical spacing changed for A29→A30 (about 4–5 steps to 2) and A40→A25 (about 2 steps to 4–5) [LAG026, LAG029].
